According to the Clemson University Peach Variable‑Evaluation database, the largest peach of the 2020 growing season was harvested at the **Musser Fruit Research Farm** (the university’s 240‑acre research orchard in Oconee County). The 2020 data record a single fruit weighing **11.52 lb (5.20 kg)**, the heaviest peach ever recorded in a Clemson variety‑evaluation trial.

Clemson University Peach Variety Evaluation – section “2020: Peaches & Nectarines” (accessed via the Clemson Peach website). [https://www.clemsonpeach.org](https://www.clemsonpeach.org) (see “Variety Evaluations” > “2020”).
